name: How does trim selection impact the overall look of a room?

mainEntity.name: How does trim selection impact the overall look of a room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trim selection significantly influences a room's character and perceived scale. Wider, more ornate trim can add a sense of luxury and traditional elegance, while simpler, narrower profiles contribute to a contemporary or transitional feel. Our design team considers trim as a critical element in enhancing a room's architectural integrity and ensuring a unified aesthetic during any substantial residential design-build project, preventing disconnected or unharmonious elements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Trim selection impacts a room's character and scale; ornate trim adds luxury, while simple trim offers a contemporary feel. Our design team integrates trim to ensure architectural integrity.
